shell_commands.command: pwd; ls -la; if [ -d /testbed ]; then cd /testbed && git status --short && sed -n '1,180p' /opt/peeky/docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md; fi

cd /testbed && sed -n '1,220p' src/parser.y && sed -n '580,800p' src/parser.y && sed -n '1,150p' tests/jq.test && sed -n '1,100p' tests/jqtest && grep -n 'TESTS\|jq.test' Makefile.am && ./jq -n '{"media:content":{"media:credits":"value"}} | .["media:content"].["media:credits"]'

cd /testbed && rg -n 'Generic Object Index|Object Identifier|\.\["foo"\]|Array/String Slice|Object Index' docs/content/manual* && rg -n 'gen_index|gen_slice|Term.*\[' src/parser.y && rg -n '^\.[^ ]*\[|slice|optional|\.foo.bar|\["foo"\]' tests/jq.test | head -90 && git diff --stat && command -v apply_patch

cd /testbed && git --no-pager log -4 --oneline && git --no-pager diff -- src/parser.c src/parser.h | head -140 && grep -n -E 'gen_index|gen_slice|Term.*\[' src/parser.y && sed -n '125,250p' tests/jq.test && find docs/content -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*manual*' -o -name '*.yml' | head -30 && command -v apply_patch; printf '%s\n' '{"title":"Title 1","media:content":{"media:credits":"media:content.media:credits 1"}}' | ./jq '{title, credits: .["media:content"].["media:credits"]}'

cd /testbed && grep -n -E 'Generic Object Index|Object Identifier|\.\["foo"\]|Array/String Slice|Object Index' docs/content/manual*/*.yml && sed -n '1,110p' tests/setup && grep -n -E 'Term.*\[|gen_index_opt\(\(yyvsp\[-5\]' src/parser.c | head -30 && git --no-pager show HEAD:src/parser.y | sed -n '690,760p'

cd /testbed && sed -n '340,480p' docs/content/manual/manual.yml && sed -n '790,820p' src/parser.y && sed -n '1,100p' tests/mantest && sed -n '80,135p' Makefile.am && ls /usr/bin/apply_patch /usr/local/bin/apply_patch /opt/*/apply_patch 2>/dev/null; command -v bison; ./jq -n '{foo:[0,1,2,3]} | .foo.[1:3]'; ./jq -n '{foo:[1,2]} | .foo.[]'

cd /testbed && grep -n -E 'slice|\[1:|path\(|\|=|\.[a-z]+\[' tests/jq.test | head -90 && git --no-pager diff --numstat && type apply_patch || true && find /testbed -name '*AGENTS*' -o -name '*CONTRIBUTING*'
cd /testbed && git --no-pager diff -- src/parser.y && ls src/parser.y* && grep -n -E 'IndexBase|YACC|BISON|parser.c:' Makefile | head -25 && sed -n '680,750p' src/parser.y && command -v python3

cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('tests/jq.test')
s = p.read_text()
anchor = '."foo"."bar"\n{"foo": {"bar": 20}}\n20\n'
assert s.count(anchor) == 1
s = s.replace(anchor, anchor + '''
# Chained generic indexes, with and without a separating dot
[.["foo"].["bar"], .foo.["bar"], .["foo"].bar, .foo.bar, .["foo"]["bar"]]
{"foo": {"bar": 42}, "bar": "badvalue"}
[42,42,42,42,42]

{title, credits: .["media:content"].["media:credits"]}
{"title":"Title 1","media:content":{"media:credits":"media:content.media:credits 1"}}
{"title":"Title 1","credits":"media:content.media:credits 1"}

[.foo.[.key], .foo[.key], .foo.["bar", "baz"]]
{"foo":{"bar":42,"baz":43},"key":"bar"}
[42,42,42,43]

.foo.[0].["bar"]
{"foo":[{"bar":42}]}
42

[.[] | .["foo"]?.["bar"]?]
[1,[2],[],{"foo":3},{"foo":{"bar":4}},{}]
[4,null]

[path(.["foo"].["bar"]), (.foo.["bar"] |= . + 1)]
{"foo":{"bar":42}}
[["foo","bar"],{"foo":{"bar":43}}]

[.foo.[], .foo[]]
{"foo":[1,2]}
[1,2,1,2]

[.[] | .foo.[]?]
[{"foo":1},{"foo":null},{"foo":[1,2]},{"foo":{"bar":3}}]
[1,2,3]

[.foo.[1:3], .foo.[1:], .foo.[:3], .foo.[1:3]?, .foo.[1:]?, .foo.[:3]?]
{"foo":[0,1,2,3,4]}
[[1,2],[1,2,3,4],[0,1,2],[1,2],[1,2,3,4],[0,1,2]]

[.foo.[1:3], .foo.[1:], .foo.[:3], .foo.[1:3]?, .foo.[1:]?, .foo.[:3]?]
{"foo":"abcde"}
["bc","bcde","abc","bc","bcde","abc"]

[.[] | .foo.[1:3]?]
[{"foo":1},{"foo":null},{"foo":"abcdef"},{"foo":{}},{"foo":[]},{"foo":[1,2,3,4,5]}]
[null,"bc",[],[2,3]]

[path(.foo.[]), (.foo.[] |= . + 1)]
{"foo":[1,2]}
[["foo",0],["foo",1],{"foo":[2,3]}]

[path(.foo.[1:3]), (.foo.[1:3] = [8])]
{"foo":[0,1,2,3,4]}
[["foo",{"start":1,"end":3}],{"foo":[0,8,3,4]}]
''')
p.write_text(s)
p = Path('docs/content/manual/manual.yml')
s = p.read_text()
anchor = '          only for identifier-like strings).\n'
assert s.count(anchor) == 1
s = s.replace(anchor, anchor + '''
          Indexes can be chained, with or without a separating dot:
          `.["foo"].["bar"]` and `.["foo"]["bar"]` are equivalent to
          `.foo.bar`.

        examples:
          - program: '.["media:content"].["media:credits"]'
            input: '{"media:content":{"media:credits":"Alice"}}'
            output: ['"Alice"']
''')
anchor = '          element, -2 referring to the next to last element, and so on.\n'
assert s.count(anchor) == 1
s = s.replace(anchor, anchor + '\n          Array indexes can also be chained: `.foo[0]` and `.foo.[0]`\n          are equivalent.\n')
anchor = '          case it refers to the start or end of the array).\n'
assert s.count(anchor) == 1
s = s.replace(anchor, anchor + '\n          Slices can also be chained: `.foo[1:3]` and `.foo.[1:3]`\n          are equivalent.\n')
anchor = '          the values of the object.\n'
assert s.count(anchor) == 1
s = s.replace(anchor, anchor + '\n          Iterators can also be chained: `.foo[]` and `.foo.[]`\n          are equivalent.\n')
p.write_text(s)
PY
./jq --run-tests tests/jq.test > /tmp/jq-chain-tests.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -15 /tmp/jq-chain-tests.log; exit "$result"

grep -n -B 4 -A 8 -E 'malformed|FAILED|FAIL|Invalid|Expected|not match|error' /tmp/jq-chain-tests.log | head -180; cd /testbed && git --no-pager diff -- src/parser.y docs/content/manual/manual.yml tests/jq.test && sed -n '1760,1825p' tests/jq.test && grep -n -E 'DECNUM|TEST|SKIP' src/jq_test.c | head -40
cd /testbed && make check > /tmp/jq-chain-check.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -65 /tmp/jq-chain-check.log; exit "$result"

cd /testbed && git status --short && git --no-pager diff --stat && git diff --check && grep -n '^#line' src/parser.c | head -5 && grep -n -E '^AM_YFLAGS|^YFLAGS|^BUILD_DOCS|^ENABLE_DOCS' Makefile && sed -n '155,198p' Makefile.am && ls docs && sed -n '1,110p' docs/Makefile.am && tail -5 tests/jqtest.log

cd /testbed && printf '%s\n' '{"title":"Title 1","media:content":{"media:credits":"media:content.media:credits 1"}}' | ./jq -e '{title, credits: .["media:content"].["media:credits"]} == {title:"Title 1",credits:"media:content.media:credits 1"}' && ./jq -en '{foo:[0,1,2,3]} | [.foo.[1:3], .foo.[1:].[]] == [[1,2],1,2,3]' && python3 - <<'PY'
import yaml
from pathlib import Path
m = yaml.safe_load(Path('docs/content/manual/manual.yml').read_text())
print('Manual YAML parsed successfully')
PY

cd /testbed && tail -3 tests/jqtest.log && ./jq -en '{"media:content":{"media:credits":"Alice"}} | .["media:content"].["media:credits"] == "Alice"' && git diff --check && git --no-pager diff -- src/parser.y | tail -15 && rm /tmp/jq-chain-build.log /tmp/jq-chain-tests.log /tmp/jq-chain-check.log

build_or_test_commands: cd /testbed && make check > /tmp/jq-chain-check.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -65 /tmp/jq-chain-check.log; exit "$result"
